messages:
maria: Quick poll — final polish on the latency vs $/token visuals before tomorrow's webinar. Draft attached. Need: one hero chart, one 3-panel breakdown, and a short runbook for the demo flow. Thoughts?
dan: Looks good. Can we tighten the x-axis labels? people get confused by p50/p95 mix.
ashley: Agree with Dan. Also let's surface 'Dedicated vs Hosted' callouts on hero.
kevin: @ashley +1. For hero idea: show two curves (latency vs cost) with annotated operating points: 'fastpath' (hosted) and 'economy' (quantized dedicated).
maria: Perfect. Dan, can you generate the updated plot with those annotations? Need SVG by 11am PT.
dan: On it. Will use the dataset from last run: /gdrive/bench/latency_cost_aug.csv. Quick note: p95 tail spikes on >1k tokens — should we cap at 2k tokens on the x-axis?
tess: Cap sounds smart for clarity. For the 3-panel, recommend: left=throughput vs cost, middle=tail-latency distribution, right=case studies (SMB vs Enterprise).
maria: Nice. Also scripting: keep webinar CTA focused: 'try Redwood Hosted free, then reserve Dedicated for production' — we need 2 CTA variants for A/B.
ashley: Copy options: V1: 'Start with Hosted — deploy fast, scale later.' V2: 'Predictable latency & cost for production — reserve capacity today.' I'll draft email copy.
kevin: Inbound routing: route Hosted signups to self-serve flow; high-usage or security keywords => enterprise SDRs. Can we add an automation rule?
maria: Yes — @bench-bot can we add rule: if usage_estimate>100k tokens or keyword in signup_notes includes 'SLA' or 'VPC' then tag as 'enterprise'?
bench-bot: Rule created: tag=enterprise when (estimated_tokens>100000) OR (notes contains 'SLA'|'VPC'). Alerts to #sales-enterprise.
dan: SVG exported, updated axes and annotations, pushing link: https://gdrive/.../latency_econ_hero_v2.svg
ashley: :thumbsup: looks cleaner. Minor tweak: make 'economy' point use dashed line and include quantization note.
dan: done. Also attached chart specs:
```
chart: latency_vs_cost
x: tokens
y: median_latency_ms
series: hosted,dedicated_quantized
annotations: fastpath,economy
cap_x: 2000
```
tess: Runbook draft for demo:
1) show hero chart (30s)
2) demo 50-token prompt on Hosted (live) (2m)
3) show cost delta with quantized dedicated (1m)
4) Q&A + CTA (close)
We need time markers and who speaks.
maria: Assign: Maria opens + hero, Dan runs live demo, Ashley hits case studies, Tess handles CTA & routing. Add rehearsal at 2pm tomorrow.
kevin: I'll set up inbound tagging rule in CRM and create the SDR playbook snippet.
maria: Thanks all. Final deliverables: SVG hero, 3-panel PNGs, runbook doc, two CTA variants, CRM rule. Ping here when done.
dan: All done except CTA copy. ETA 10am
ashley: CTA copy in draft: https://docs/.../cta_variants.md
bench-bot: Reminder set: rehearsal tomorrow 14:00 PT.
maria: Awesome :party-parrot: — last check by 10:30 pls.
